description: Unidentified Dagger/Finger airframe towed from Área Material Río Cuarto on 28 March 2022 and fixed on three concrete pillars; monument to the 1982 veterans and to 1st Lt José Ardiles, inaugurated 2 April 2022. Identity not established (Gaceta Aeronáutica 2023).
